title: Risk Factors for Low Back Pain in Adults a 23-year Prospective Cohort Study of 14-15-year-old Schoolchildren.
brief_summary: The incidence of low back pain (LBP) is increasing and prognostic factors for developing LBP are unclear. Based on questionnaires, different prognostic factors are being explored over time.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Being a member of the original Western Zealand cohort
* Ability to understand and write in Danish
* Having access to the Danish digital mail system "e-Boks". (Access to e-Boks is mandatory in Denmark unless you have special needs)

Exclusion Criteria:

We have no formal exclusion criterias
study_population: This is an inception cohort where all participants will be around 38 years
